assertions.name: frame_change_is_an_exact_identity
assertions.source: sympy: ℏ_q(q+1) − h and u − b·h²/(q+1)² both simplify to 0 identically in q. Proved over a generic field in QOU.QBeta.hbar_mul_succ_eq_h / u_eq_b_mul_h_sq_div.

assertions.name: model_has_a_nonzero_ODD_h_rung_unreachable_from_u
assertions.source: nonzero odd-order rungs at h^[3, 5, 7]; h³ = −√3/64 is purely irrational. Since uᵏ ∝ h²ᵏ (QOU.QBeta.u_pow_eq_even_h_pow), no u-ladder can produce any of them — this is the exact form of 'odd rungs are structurally unrepresentable in u'.

assertions.name: conversion_factor_is_not_its_q_to_1_limit
assertions.source: b/(q+1)² = 0.1948747063 at the proton anchor vs √3/8 = 0.2165063509, a -10.0% difference. Using the q→1 limit as the conversion is a ~10% error, which is why the exact identity matters rather than the asymptotic.

description: T1 of bean qou-cwin. Establishes that the u→h frame change is an exact identity (u = b·h²/(q+1)², from ℏ_q(q+1) = h) rather than the asymptotic 'u ∼ h² near q=1', and derives the consequence that uᵏ = (b/(q+1)²)ᵏ·h²ᵏ — so a u-rung of order k lands at h-order 2k and a u-ladder spans only EVEN h-orders. Odd h-orders are unreachable by any choice of u-coefficients, and the model's h³ rung (−√3/64) is nonzero and purely irrational. Also records the exact ℚ(√3) h-frame rungs through h⁷, and that the conversion factor b/(q+1)² ≈ 0.1949 differs from its q→1 limit √3/8 ≈ 0.2165 by ~10%. Companion to the sorry-free Lean in QOU/QBeta/LadderFrameChange.lean. No physical claim: no c_k value, no derivation of α, no accuracy improvement — the cross-anchor instability is 2.3748% in both frames.
